对一组平级的元素进行轮播切换。.en-us: Cycle through a group of sibling elements.

设置参数`autoplay=True`开启自动轮播。.en-us: Set `autoplay=True` to enable automatic slide transitions.

设置参数`autoplaySpeed`控制自动轮播间隔时长。.en-us: Use `autoplaySpeed` to set the autoplay interval.

设置参数`dotPosition`控制走马灯指示器位置。.en-us: Use `dotPosition` to position the carousel indicators.

设置参数`speed`控制切换动画过程毫秒耗时。.en-us: Use `speed` to set the transition duration in milliseconds.

通过参数`slidesToShow`控制同时展示的子项数量。.en-us: Use `slidesToShow` to set the number of simultaneously visible slides.

通过参数`slidesToScroll`控制每次轮播划过的子项数量。.en-us: Use `slidesToScroll` to set the number of slides advanced per transition.

配置`autoplay`参数开启指示器倒计时动画。.en-us: Configure `autoplay` to enable indicator countdown animations.
